valuation_template_rationale: Canadian Solar combines minority-owned manufacturing, storage and project-development assets with volatile consolidated earnings, material project financing and uncertain common-share value realization, so a discounted attributable-book-value NAV is more decision-useful than a single earnings multiple.
bear_assumptions: Apply approximately 0.25x to June 2026 attributable book value per share if module oversupply and weak normalized margins persist, inventory continues to consume cash, refinancing pressure rises and further project-sale delays sustain a deep asset-value discount.
base_assumptions: Apply approximately 0.45x to June 2026 attributable book value per share if storage growth and second-half project sales partly offset module weakness while leverage, cash conversion and minority interests continue to limit common-share value realization.
bull_assumptions: Apply approximately 0.65x to June 2026 attributable book value per share if storage scales profitably, delayed projects monetize, localized manufacturing improves mix, working capital releases and consolidated debt declines.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade requires an accepted material relationship, adequate expected-to-bear payoff and primary evidence that normalized margin, working-capital cash conversion, delayed project sales and debt are improving. Downgrade if storage growth slows, normalized margin misses guidance, project sales slip again, inventories or debt keep rising, liquidity tightens or dilution materially increases.
